PART III — LANDS

No. 1990/5 – MONDAY, OCTOBER 24, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT(CHAPTER 460) AS
AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF
(Notice under Section 7)
My No.: BLDS/LND/7/1/6/114. Ministry file No.: 4-3/9/2015/WS/26.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land /servitude to be acquired:-

The allotments of land in Extent about 0.5816 Hectare, depicted in Sheet No. 05 Plan Zonal 01 from Zonal 03 in C.M. No. 620087 prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated at Ellewatta Village, 256-B Kiridigala Grama Niladhari Division, Helauda Minor Division, Balangoda Divisional Secretariat, Rathnapura District and Sabaragamuwa Province.
The Schedule 1. Lot No. 67 Name of Land:—; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.1671 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 69 Name of Land: Benkiyawatta, Pahalakumburewatta; Claimant: Sumedha Basnayaka, 93, Kaltota Road, Balangoda and others; Extent: 0.3937 Hectare.
3. Lot No. 71 Name of Land:—; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0115 Hectare.
4. Lot No. 72 Name of Land:—; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0058 Hectare.
5. Lot No. 73 Name of Land:—; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0035 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Balangoda Divisional Secretariat on the 30th November, 2016 at 10.00 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 23rd November, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
CHAMPIKA NIROSH DHARMAPALA, Divisional Secretary, Balangoda.
At the Balangoda Divisional Secretary’s Office, 20th October, 2016. 11– 415

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT(CHAPTER No. 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: LA/227. Land Min. No.: 03/J/80/LG/773.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a planning proposal on village creation of Katharagama.

Description of the land to be acquired: The allotment of Land in F.T.P. 25, Supplement No. 40, Sheet No. 94 prepared by the superintend surveyor in Monaragala, situated in Katharagama village in the Katharagama Divisional Secretary’s Division of the District of Monaragala in Uva province described as follows:—

1. Lot No. 2064 Name of Land: Nikagahawattha; Claimant: Trustee of the Katharagama Dewalaya and Maddumapatabandige Ensohami, Abesingha Madduma Patabandige Peeter Silwa, Katharagama; Extent: 0.313 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 2065 Name of Land: Papolgahawattha; Claimant: Trustee of the Katharagama Dewalaya and Gallage Sumanasena, Katharagama; Extent: 0.124 Hectare.
3. Lot No. 2066 Name of Land: Thekkagahawattha; Claimant: Trustee of the Katharagama Dewalaya and Bambaranda Guruge Mandis Appu, Bambaranda Guruge Wijayapala, Katharagama; Extent: 0.149 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Katharagama Divisional Secretariat on the 18th day of November, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25th day of November, 2016 the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars or their claims for Compensation for the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. S.C. WEERAKONE, Divisional Secretary, Katharagama. Divisional Secretariat, Katharagama, 19th October, 2016. 11– 416
